prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a warrior-mage in dark steel half-plate over a hooded deep crimson tabard, the hood up over a shadowed face with two pale eyes, holding one straight sword in the hand on the right side of the image and one round dark shield with a simple glowing teal crescent-moon emblem on the other arm, close to the body; in the idle cell the sword is held upright beside the shield; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides, the sword point well below the top of the grey box. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: a shadowed face with two pale eyes inside the hood.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, stepping forward toward the heroes behind the raised shield, the sword thrust low past the shield's edge with the elbow bent, the whole sword well inside the middle cell, the crescent emblem glowing brighter, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the hooded head thrown back, the shield lifted up in front of the chest, the sword in the same hand, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight onto one leg and lean the torso toward the heroes behind the shield, the elbows bent, so the sword and shield stay well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape or cloak, and no slash trail, spell effects, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a cape, a helmet, a second sword, a staff, a plume, a skull face, black plate, a spell effect away from the shield, runes, letters, crosses, hooked symbols.
